excerpt.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
excerpt.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

texts.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
texts.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

sections.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
sections.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

texts.zh: 在调查[From.GetName]时，[Root.GetName]的船员惊讶地发现小行星内部竟然出现了生命的迹象。某种穴居虫类无机体生命居住在被暗道遍布的岩石之中。这种独特的生命体似乎已经适应了太空的严寒。
texts.en: Amazingly, while conducting their survey of [From.GetName], the crew of the [Root.GetName] picked up several life signs coming from within the asteroid. There appears to be a colony of large burrowing worm-like lithovores within the rock, which has been riddled with tunnels. These unique life forms have somehow adapted to a life in the coldness of space.

label.zh: 应该好好研究一下这些生物。

texts.zh: [From.GetName]上生活的生命体形式和我们预想的完全不一样。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报到，小行星内有不断生长的水晶。这些生命体利用[From.System.GetName]散发的辐射，并结合小行星内的矿物元素，被证实能够完成自给自足的繁衍生息。
texts.en: The lifeforms living on [From.GetName] were nothing like we expected. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] report back that the asteroid has crystal growths. These growths have turned out to be self-sustaining and caused by the crystals taking in the ambient radiation of [From.System.GetName] and combining it with the mineral composition of the asteroid.

texts.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，十分易碎。
texts.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and are quite brittle.

texts.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，想必具有潜在的食用价值。
texts.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and could potentially even be edible.
